title: Chromatographic separation of neodymium isotopes in human dental enamel for TIMS analysis
author: Esther Plomp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xzmfp46
materials: Sample the enamel using a micro-drill fitted with a cleaned diamond-tipped rotary burr and blade (Minilor Perceuse). Burrs and blades should be cleaned before sampling teeth from different individuals to prevent contamination: Rinse with ethanol, 3 N HNO 3 (Sigma-Aldrich Company Ltd) and ultrasound for 3 minutes, rinse with Milli-Q and ethanol. Let the burrs and blades dry on aluminium foil. Clean the workspace with ethanol before sampling and prior to sampling different individuals. When sampling, ensure dentine separation from the enamel. Collect sampled enamel on aluminium foil prior to collecting the enamel in small glass bottles or cleaned eppendorf centrifuge tubes (6-7 N HCl (Sigma-Aldrich Company Ltd) for > 7 days). Combine the enamel from multiple teeth from the same individual if available.
Leach the teeth for >8 hours in 30% H 2 O 2 (Sigma-Aldrich Company Ltd). Put the lids on the tubes but do not seal. Rinse the teeth with Milli-Q (>3 times) and dry on a hotplate at 50 °C .

Measure sample and spike bottle weight before and after addition of the spike to calculate the amount of spike added. Dissolve the enamel in 3–6 mL 6.5 N HCl (> 12 hours). Dry (> 12 hours) and nitrate again before dissolving in 10 mL 2.0 N HNO 3 (> 12 hours). Make sure there is no precipitate in the solution.

Clean the PFA laboratory equipment: sub-boil in pro-analysis quality 7 N HNO 3 and 6 N HCl for 2 hours each, followed by two leaching steps at 125 °C with (1) double distilled 6.5 N HCl (>5 days) and (2) 7 N HNO 3 /12 N HF (≥40%Sigma-Aldrich Company Ltd) (>2 days). steps.title: Collect and dry teeth samples
steps.instruction: Place each tooth into a cleaned 50 mL plastic centrifuge tube that has been rinsed more than three times with Milli‑Q water and once with ethanol (Purity Grade: absolut, CHROMASOLV® for HPLC). Dry the teeth on a hotplate set to 50 °C, avoiding higher temperatures that could melt the plastic.

steps.title: Prepare TRU‑resin columns and load sample
steps.instruction: Separate REE from the enamel matrix using the TRU‑resin protocol, then the Ln‑resin protocol to isolate Nd.

substeps.instruction: Determine TRU‑resin volume: use 0.75 mL resin for samples ≤ 550 mg, or 1.3 mL resin for samples > 550 mg; pack the resin into modified Pasteur‑pipette columns.
Ultrasonicate the tooth powder for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the sonicated suspension for 4 minutes at 4000 rpm.
Clean each TRU‑resin column sequentially with 6 mL 2 N HF, 6 mL Milli‑Q water, 6 mL 2 N HNO₃, and 6 mL Milli‑Q water.
Pre‑condition the column with 6 mL 2 N HNO₃.
Prefraction (25 column volumes): flush with 19 mL 2 N HNO₃ if using 0.75 mL resin, or 33 mL 2 N HNO₃ if using 1.3 mL resin.
Load the sample onto the column using 10 mL 2 N HNO₃.
Wash the column with 9 mL 2 N HNO₃ (0.75 mL resin) or 23 mL 2 N HNO₃ (1.3 mL resin).
Extract the REE fraction (10 column volumes) with 8 mL Milli‑Q water (0.75 mL resin) or 14 mL Milli‑Q water (1.3 mL resin).

steps.title: Dry REE fraction overnight
steps.instruction: Place the collected REE eluate on a hotplate set to 120 °C and dry it overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Ln‑resin columns for Nd separation
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried REE fraction in 2 mL 0.165 N HCl and pass it through Ln‑resin columns (0.74 mL resin, PE‑column with 35 µm PE‑frit) to isolate Nd.

substeps.instruction: Day 1 column cleaning: sequentially flush with 4 mL 6 N HNO₃, 4 mL 2 N HF, 4 mL Milli‑Q water, 4 mL 6‑7 N HCl, and finally 1 mL 0.165 N HCl.
Store the cleaned columns overnight in 0.165 N HCl contained in 10 mL centrifuge tubes that have been cleaned with 6‑7 N HCl for more than 7 days.
Day 2 column cleaning: flush with 2 mL 6‑7 N HCl followed by 2 mL Milli‑Q water.
Pre‑condition the column with 2 mL 0.165 N HCl.
Prefraction: pass 9‑11 mL 0.165 N HCl through the column (volume depends on column usage time).
Load the dissolved REE sample onto the column using 1‑2 mL 0.165 N HCl.
Wash the column with 7‑10 mL 0.165 N HCl.
Extract Nd with 4 mL 0.3 N HCl.

steps.title: Dry and nitrate Nd fraction for TIMS
steps.instruction: Prepare the isolated Nd eluate for TIMS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Dry the Nd eluate on a hotplate at 110 °C.
Add 10 drops of 14 N HNO₃ to nitrate the residue.
Close the vial and heat on a hotplate at 120 °C for 2 hours, tapping down condensation droplets every 30 minutes.
Open the vial and perform a final dry‑down at 110 °C before TIMS measurement.
